checks.name: help
checks.stdout:
usage: replay.py [-h] [--source-root SOURCE_ROOT] [--lean LEAN] [--check-only]
                 [--entry ENTRY] [--all-source] [--workers {1,2}]
                 [--seconds SECONDS] [--label LABEL]

Isolated bounded source-only Lean replay; never executes native workers.
Windows: Python 3.11+ with psutil and Lean 4.33.1. This local source bundle
does not need the original research tree. Pass --lean and optionally --source-
root. All replay outputs remain below this script's own directory. Other
operating systems are not validated by this Windows Job resource-limited
driver.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-root SOURCE_ROOT
                        Folder holding the exact manifest-listed source files
  --lean LEAN           Lean 4.33.1 executable or elan proxy
  --check-only          Validate source hashes and imports without invoking
                        Lean
  --entry ENTRY
  --all-source
  --workers {1,2}
  --seconds SECONDS
  --label LABEL
